lines.en: I sway along the riverbed slowly.

lines.zh: 水流从我的长吻上滑过。
lines.en: The current slides along my long snout.
I swim past a sunken log.
Shadows from the bank fall down.

lines.zh: 咬一口我就换目标，别追。
lines.en: One bite and I switch targets; do not chase.
The riverbed sand lifts me.

lines.zh: 我摆尾借水流，滑过石缝。
lines.en: I tail-flick into the current and glide past the stones.
My scales can be shaved into fletching.
I hug the stone shelf in the bend.
A school of small fish scatters.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片能拿去削箭杆。
lines.en: My scales can be shaved down into arrow shafts.

lines.zh: 阳光碎在水面，我贴着河床游。
lines.en: Sunlight shatters on the surface; I swim along the bed.

lines.zh: 我藏在倒木下，只露出一双眼。
lines.en: Under a fallen log, I show only my eyes.
My tail stirs a little mud.
I barely move in the water.
I creep toward the riverbank.
I hang in the river perfectly still.
Only my gills are moving.
I know this river.
The current over my back feels good.

lines.zh: 我张开长吻，让水流过牙。
lines.en: I open my long snout and let the water run through my teeth.
A small fish is coming.
Someone is walking on the bank.
These scales of mine work like flint.

lines.zh: 河泥裹住我的腹鳍，很凉。
lines.en: River mud wraps my belly fins, cold and soft.
I bury myself in the sand.
This bend of the river belongs to me alone.

lines.zh: 水草在我旁边摇，河底的鱼在动。
lines.en: Waterweed sways beside me and fish stir on the bed.
My snout is longer than your arm.
I wait here.
You're standing on my water's edge.
Your reflection told me first.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好落进水里。
lines.en: Your shadow lands right in the water.
My scales can be made into arrows.
The water's not deep. I can reach.

lines.zh: 手别探进水里，我的牙很快。
lines.en: Don't put your hand in the water. My teeth are quick.
It isn't your hand I'm watching.
It's your feet.
Keep your hand off the water. Back up.
I'm still waiting.
Your weapon scraped my scales.
I tumbled along the bed.
Blood doesn't show in the river.
In deeper water, I raise my scales.

lines.zh: 硬鳞被撬开，血在水里散。
lines.en: A hard scale is pried loose; blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 伤不深，我甩尾游回深处。
lines.en: The wound is shallow; I flick my tail back to the deep.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍得河底一声闷响。
lines.en: My tail thumps the riverbed.
That punch of yours lands heavy.
I sink down and hide in the silt.

lines.zh: 被叉了一下，我钻进深水。
lines.en: Pitched once, I dive for deeper water.
What did you throw in?
That meat on the bank is still dripping blood.
I watch it sink.
No rush. It can't get away.
You still have meat between your fingers.
Throw in some more.
I rise slowly from the bottom.
That's not one mouthful for me.
Don't reel the line back in.

lines.zh: 一丝血味，从上游漂下来。
lines.en: A thread of blood drifts down from upstream.
You crashed into the water.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，从另一边浮上。
lines.en: I sank and surfaced on your other side.
I'm more agile than you in the water.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踢到我的侧腹。
lines.en: Your boot kicked my flank.
My scales can be ground into arrowheads.

lines.zh: 你下水撞上我，鳞片刮过腿。
lines.en: You step in and hit me; my scales rake your leg.
You can't stand steady.
My body slid away.
You stepped into the soft bed.
I make the rules here.
I'm the only one in this stretch.
Such things belong in the water.
River scales make good fletching.
My teeth don't retract.
There's another upstream.
Not my concern.
I'm used to being here.
Get back on the bank.
I keep swimming.
The water never carried that.

lines.zh: 我咬住那块肉，甩头撕开。
lines.en: I clamp the meat and thrash my head to tear it.
This shell won't crack. I spit it out.
I flung it up onto the bank.
What you throw in is mine.
This has no smell of blood.
I spat it out.
It sank to the bed.
I don't need it.
Stop throwing things in.
The meat on the riverbed goes down in one gulp.
Movement on the bank.
That disturbance on the surface is not wind.

lines.zh: 我摆尾转身，长吻对准你。
lines.en: I swing my tail around and aim my long snout at you.
This is a good chance.
The water is shallow. I can get up there.
I lift my head above the surface.

lines.zh: 咬一口就换目标，我从不恋战。
lines.en: One bite and I switch targets. Never linger.

lines.zh: 我把长身沉进河底，只留眼。
lines.en: I sink my long body to the bed and show only my eyes.
There's a slope on that stretch of bank.
I'll go up there.
I follow along the bottom.
Its shadow moves along the bank.

lines.zh: 岸上每一下震动我都数着。
lines.en: I count every thump on the bank.

lines.zh: 你在岸边停住，我还在等。
lines.en: You stop at the bank. I keep waiting.
The water hides my noise.

lines.zh: 我的背和河底一个颜色。
lines.en: My back matches the riverbed.
It walked two steps toward the river.

lines.zh: 我等你再靠近浅水一步。
lines.en: I wait for one more step into the shallows.
The bank slopes here.
One bite, then I switch targets.
I snap suddenly.
I caught it.
One bite will settle it.
I turn away at once.
Bite once and move on.
I swam back and forth twice.
This one isn't worth staying for.
I bite again from a new angle.

lines.zh: 我的牙合上，水里泛起红。
lines.en: My jaws close and the water reddens.
I sink away.

lines.zh: 河心冒出一串泡，我浮上来。
lines.en: Bubbles rise mid-river and I surface.
The surface turned over.
This river is my hunting ground.
I came down from upstream.
The birds on the bank all flew.
I sway my body slowly.
The water is murky. Hard to see me.
I stop in the stone's shadow.
There are no others of my kind here.
I swim toward the bank again.

lines.zh: 水面上烧起来，我拼命往下沉。
lines.en: The surface is burning. I dive deep.
Just a fall into the water.

lines.zh: 水里我本来就在，可这水很脏。
lines.en: I live in water, but this water is foul.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀开，我被推出去。
lines.en: The blast split the water and threw me.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面，扎进我的背。
lines.en: An arrow pierced the surface and struck my back.
A crackle of light spread through the water.
There's little left to bite in the river.

lines.zh: 闪电顺着水面爬过来，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning crawled over the surface and numbed me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有腮，也没有水。
lines.en: No gills, no water in the void.
